summary: Plugin specification và chính thức extensions cho Cursor, trình soạn thảo code AI dựa trên kiến trúc VS Code.
usecases: Extend Cursor's AI capabilities with custom language support and tool integrations.
Automate repetitive coding tasks through plugin-developed shortcuts and workflows.
Integrate third-party APIs and development tools directly into the Cursor editor.
ideas: Build a plugin that auto-generates unit tests from code in the editor.
Create a plugin that syncs Cursor's AI context with a local knowledge base or documentation site.
Develop a plugin that visualizes code metrics and complexity heatmaps in real-time.
